LanguageData.WR_Rec1: Weapons and armor by role and situation
LanguageData.WR_Rec2: Work clothes from the editor (filled automatically)
LanguageData.WR_Rec3: Worn-out pieces replaced, never dead man's clothes
LanguageData.WR_Rec4: Sleepwear at night, festive clothes on holidays and parties
LanguageData.WR_Rec5: Favourite outfit kept in the colonist's bedroom
LanguageData.WR_Rec6: Tailor planner – bills only when you confirm
LanguageData.WR_Enabled_Desc: On: Smart Colonist Gear asks Wardrobe at every dressing decision. Off: Smart Colonist Gear decides on its own, exactly as without this add-on.
LanguageData.WR_TakesOver: Dressing is managed by Wardrobe. Smart Colonist Gear still finds the gear, Wardrobe has the last word.
LanguageData.WR_ScgDecides: Wardrobe is off – Smart Colonist Gear decides on its own.
LanguageData.WR_OverviewText: Every rule starts from Smart Colonist Gear's own choice, so with untouched tables colonists dress as before – the tabs only add your wishes on top.
LanguageData.WR_RolesSkills: skills (the strongest skill whose work the colonist does)
LanguageData.WR_SidearmsNote: Simple Sidearms is active: the role table picks the primary weapon, Simple Sidearms keeps the sidearms.
LanguageData.WR_RoleWeapons_Desc: A weapon of the wanted kind is preferred (×1.35), other kinds are less wanted (×0.75).
LanguageData.WR_DamagedWeapon_Desc: A weapon below this condition counts much less, so a better one is taken when there is one.
LanguageData.WR_WeaponsText: The table only weighs Smart Colonist Gear's weapon score – research, era and skill still decide first.
LanguageData.WR_ArmorSets_Desc: Pieces of the wanted weight are preferred; heavier ones are avoided outside a fight.
LanguageData.WR_ArmorText: Situations: defense = raid or drafted, hunt = going hunting, caravan = travelling. Otherwise the role decides.
LanguageData.WR_WorkEditor_Desc: Which apparel is work clothing for which work. Off: Smart Colonist Gear's own detection.
LanguageData.WR_WorkText: Filled automatically with what Smart Colonist Gear detects. Add or remove pieces – colonists put them on for that work and take them off afterwards.
LanguageData.WR_WorkReset: Fill again from Smart Colonist Gear
LanguageData.WR_Care_Desc: Worn-out pieces are replaced, damaged weapons swapped.
LanguageData.WR_ReplaceBelow_Desc: Vanilla gives the 'tattered apparel' mood penalty below 50 %. Above that value the piece is replaced before the penalty.
LanguageData.WR_RetireBills_Desc: Once per map one 'forever' bill at a smelter or crematorium for apparel below the threshold. If you delete it, it is not made again.
LanguageData.WR_RetireBill: Wardrobe: added a bill at {0} for tattered apparel.
LanguageData.WR_CareText: Repairs: with a mod that repairs apparel (e.g. Mending) the pieces get repaired instead – Wardrobe only stops wearing them below the threshold.
LanguageData.WR_Sleepwear_Desc: Before going to bed at night colonists put on sleepwear, in the morning they dress for work again.
LanguageData.WR_Festive_Desc: During parties, rituals and holidays idle colonists put on festive clothes.
LanguageData.WR_FestiveOnly_Desc: Outside occasions nobody wears them, so they stay clean.
LanguageData.WR_HolidaysOn: Seasons & Holidays is active: its holidays count as occasions.
LanguageData.WR_HolidaysOff: Occasions: parties and rituals (with Seasons & Holidays also its holidays).
LanguageData.WR_FestiveList: Festive clothes (found by name, edit freely):
LanguageData.WR_OccasionsReset: Find sleepwear and festive clothes again
LanguageData.WR_Uniforms_Desc: Idle colonists dye their clothes in their role's color at a styling station.
LanguageData.WR_UniformsText: Tick a role and pick its color. Needs a styling station and dye.
LanguageData.WR_NeedIdeology: Dyeing clothes needs the Ideology DLC.
LanguageData.WR_Favorites_Desc: Favourite pieces are worn only by their owner and preferred by him.
LanguageData.WR_ToBedroom: Keep favourites in the colonist's bedroom
LanguageData.WR_ToBedroom_Desc: Idle colonists carry their unworn favourites to a shelf or dresser in their own bedroom.
LanguageData.WR_FavoritesText: Select a colonist and press 'Save outfit as favourites'. A storage (shelf, dresser) in his bedroom keeps them.
LanguageData.WR_SetFavorites_Desc: Everything he wears now (and his weapon) becomes his: only he wears it, and he prefers it.
LanguageData.WR_ClearFavorites_Desc: His pieces are free for everyone again.
LanguageData.WR_Tailor_Desc: Suggests what to make. Nothing is ordered until you confirm.
LanguageData.WR_TailorText: Bare torso or legs, worn-out pieces without a spare, poor quality, missing sleepwear or festive clothes.
LanguageData.WR_NothingToMake: Nothing to make – everyone is dressed well.
LanguageData.WR_NoMap: Open a game to see this.
LanguageData.WR_ColonistsText: Tick = Wardrobe dresses the colonist. The button sets his role (* = set by you).
LanguageData.WR_MaxDistance_Desc: How far colonists walk for sleepwear or festive clothes.
LanguageData.WR_ResetAll_Confirm: Reset all Wardrobe settings and tables to the defaults?
LanguageData.WR_AdvancedText: Wardrobe checks one colonist every 1.5 seconds – no stutter even in big colonies.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
